high_level_description: The image is a line graph titled "Gross domestic expenditures on R&D, by selected country: 2000–19." The graph illustrates the trend of research and development (R&D) expenditures over time for various countries from the year 2000 to 2019. The y-axis represents the expenditures in billions of current PPP dollars, while the x-axis represents the years. Countries Represented: United States China Japan Germany South Korea France United Kingdom
